name: Hindalco Industries Ltd
title: Hindalco Industries Ltd - 500440 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Hindalco's India aluminium upstream EBITDA of $1,756/t and record copper EBITDA of INR907 cr ride on a West Asia supply shock, but management expects copper to fall back to INR600-700 cr a quarter and India capex to rise to INR12,000 cr in FY27.

capex.quote: In FY 27, the India capex will be about INR12,000 crores

triggers.label: Global aluminium deficit 0.3 → 1.5 mt CY26
triggers.quote: the market has moved from an earlier expectation of 0.3 million tons deficit to 1.5 million tons deficit for calendar year '26

triggers.label: Copper EBITDA INR907 cr, up 48%
triggers.quote: Our quarterly copper EBITDA stood at a record INR907 crores, up 48% year-on-year

triggers.label: Copper quarterly EBITDA normalising to 600-700 cr
triggers.quote: I would still go back to the 600, 700 per quarter there

triggers.label: India capex INR31,619 cr FY26, up 47%
triggers.quote: capital expenditures of INR31,619 crores, up 47% year-on-year

triggers.label: Oswego hot mill restart in weeks
triggers.quote: The Oswego Hot Mill is on track to restart in the next few weeks

guidance.quote: our long-term guidance of $600 per ton remains intact
that run rate is now $200 million as we accelerate all cost efficiency initiatives

guidance.metric: Structural cost reduction by FY28 exit
guidance.quote: permanently reducing our cost structure by $350 million to $400 million by FY 28 exit
consolidated net debt peak should be between INR80,000 crores and INR90,000 crores over the next 2 years
I would still go back to the 600, 700 per quarter there

guidance.metric: Aluminium cost of production Q1 FY27
guidance.quote: we are anticipating a 5% increase over Q4
in Q1, we expect to sell about 170
taking our total renewable capacity to 523 megawatts by the end of Q1 FY '27
